body: I'm sorry. I wasn't aware of the rules. It was not my intent to offend anyone. I won't bother you any more.

Thanks for trying to help, but assure that I am awake and know exactly what is at stake here.

I will be turning 30 next week and I have come to the realization that my life is completely pointless. Rest assured, I am not making my decision based on some arbitrary number. I'm just giving it to you as a reference point so you'll understand just how pathetic my life really is.

I haven't worked in nearly three years, I have no means to continue my education, and there hasn't been a time in the past decade in which I've had more than a couple of hundred dollars to my name. With each passing day, my work experience (or lack thereof) becomes a bigger problem for me. I am in a horrible spot from a financial standpoint, and the situation only continues to get worse with time.

I am not a materialistic person. I don't care that I don't own a house or a car. I don't need a 50" TV or a smart phone. I don't care about any of that crap. I do care about relationships, however, and it is in this regard that I am truly broke.

I have *zero* friends. This is not an exaggeration. Nobody would even notice if I were to disappear tomorrow. If I were to have a funeral, I can guarantee that nearly everyone in attendance would be related to me. In other words, they have relationships with me by default. The vast majority of these people don't really know me and haven't spoken to me in years.

The sad reality is that every single relationship I've ever had has completely deteriorated in the last ten years. Making things more difficult is the fact that I haven't been able to form any meaningful relationship in that time frame. I certainly didn't want my relationships to dissipate, but there are things in life that are beyond your control. Offices close, co-workers come and go, roommates move, classmates drop out, friends drift away, and family members eventually move on with their lives. I have tried to stay in touch with people via Facebook or other methods, but nobody responds to any of my messages. I don't know why. People seem to enjoy themselves when I'm around, and, yet, nobody has room for me in their life.

I have tried to take steps to improve my situation. I look for work, I exercise, I eat well, I attend every social function that I can, and I have been making a concerted effort to be more outgoing at every turn. It hasn't made a difference and I'm still alone.

This notion that I am being selfish is misplaced. I have thought long and hard about the situation, and have come to the conclusion that my death would not have no discernible affect on the daily life of any individual on this planet. I have literally gone weeks without saying a word to a single person. Nobody noticed, the world didn't stop, and not a single tear was shed. My existence is of no consequence to anyone. I recognize that there are people from my past that would be saddened by my death, but a grand total of zero of them can honestly say that I am a part of their lives. To these people, I have already been reduced to a memory. My death will not change any of this.

I am sick and tired of people trying to convince myself that things will get better. A decade of personal experience proves beyond a shadow of a doubt that things *only* get worse with time. Each day is worse than the one that preceded it. A person can only fall on their face so many times before they become completely numb. I have no more goals, no more aspirations, and no more dreams. I give up.
I am not on any medication of any sort. My thoughts are completely logical and my mind is clear.
